The Gaiad is the scripture of [[Alpha]]. One of the [[Three Scrolls]].

The Japanese name is Ame-tsuchi Monogatari 天地物語

The Gaiad has a [[Gaiad correction policy|correction policy]] put in place. Since its purpose is establishing cultural unity, accidental cultural appropriation or misrepresentation can hurt its message.

It has a mythological narrative of the evolution of life, influenced primarily from the [[Book of Genesis]]

In the [[Old Gaiad|earliest version]] it was mainly focused on [[Lower mythology]], which caused issues when reacing the [[Permian Triassic Extinction]].
